base: pure-oreb-turnover-time-1; generic putback risk ablation OFF
status: four seen seasons, in-sample mechanism experiment; no baseline promotion from three seeds
sample: valid individual missed-FG OREB, same special-FT exclusion and PBP coverage as putback-risk; first anchor per possession for outcome table, all anchors for first-gate observation; require >=3 period seconds for first-boundary rates
firstBoundary: first canonical event in FG, ordinary FT, ownership loss, foul; nonshooting defensive foul determined including descriptor; separate shooting foul, offensive foul and other. A foul is a boundary here, unlike prior early-window metric
hypothesis: early-window 2.04% vs 3.33% does not by itself establish an elevated per-opportunity gate. First compare first-boundary nonshooting rate, full pre-attempt nonshooting incidence and time-to-foul distribution. No ratio of early-window proportions is a calibration factor
conditionalExperiment: only if pooled real first-boundary nonshooting probability is below baseline with franchise+seed 95% interval excluding zero: test replacing first ordinary nonshooting gate after player FG OREB with per-season observed all-anchor first-boundary probability. No team or scoring inputs. This is a competing-event gate approximation, not an identified continuous hazard; intentional fouls unchanged. Otherwise stop after diagnosis, do not force candidate
guard: only first opportunity following player FG OREB and >=3 seconds remaining. Other player/FT/team retained balls and all later opportunities retain old rate. Same one RNG gate draw; flag OFF exactly baseline
nonTargets: no changes to card, OREB probability/recipient, generic turnover risk, shot probability, shooting foul outcome, pace or calibration
evaluation: 20k same franchise and seed draws across four seasons, equal-season ratio average. Three seeds are diagnostic only. If candidate worsens first-event foul distance or FT-point bias, reject; promotion would require a separate 20seed paired test. No scoring/wins parameter search
stop: finish this one mechanism and report facts, inference and failures; do not start next batch
